name: Stone Age
tagline: Hit rock with rock until it is round.
intro: You pick up a rock. You have a feeling about this rock. It wants to be round.

producers.name: Sharper Rock
producers.description: A rock for hitting the other rock into a circle.
producers.firstBuy: You have invented the tool. You use it to reinvent the wheel. Priorities.

producers.name: Cave Apprentice
producers.description: Hits rocks. Mostly the right ones.
producers.firstBuy: Your apprentice asks what a wheel is for. You do not know yet. Keep chiseling.

producers.name: Rolling Hill
producers.description: Gravity-assisted quality control. If it rolls down, it's a wheel.
producers.firstBuy: A wheel rolled down the hill and was never seen again. It was the best one.

producers.name: Wheel Shaman
producers.description: Prays to the Great Circle. Results vary, but on average: wheels.
producers.firstBuy: The Shaman declares the wheel sacred. Also declares the square cursed. Squares everywhere are nervous.

producers.name: Wheel Committee
producers.description: Twelve elders debate whether the wheel should exist. Wheels are produced during breaks.
producers.firstBuy: The Committee's first motion: rename 'wheel' to 'round rock'. Motion tabled. Wheels continue.
